October, 2024

Author: Ravindra Maithani

 High Court Of Uttarakhand At Nainital

entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Present:
 Mr. Pradeep Chamyal, Advocate for the petitioner.
Mr. Vipul Painuly, Brief Holder for the State.
Mr. Amit Rastogi, Advocate for respondent no.2.
Hon'ble Ravindra Maithani, J.(Oral)

Instant petition under Section 528 of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 has been preferred by the petitioner for quashing the Charge-Sheet No.180 of 2023, dated 20.07.2023 and Summoning Order dated 21.09.2023, under Sections 498A, 323, 504 & 506 IPC and Sections 3/4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act, 1961, passed in Criminal Case No.498 of 2023, State vs. Atul Katheria and others, by the court of Judicial Magistrate, Sitarganj, District Udham Singh Nagar (" the case")
as well as entire proceedings of the case on the basis of amicable settlement between the parties.

entities.text: State vs. Atul Katheria and others
entities.label: PRECEDENT

entities.text: Judicial Magistrate, Sitarganj, District Udham Singh Nagar
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: A joint compounding application has also been filed supported by the affidavits.
2. Heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the record.

3. According to the FIR, the petitioner no.1 and the respondent no.2 ("the informant") were married on 19.11.2021, thereafter the informant was harassed and tortured in connection with demand of dowry.
4. Learned counsel for the parties would submit that the parties have settled the dispute amicably and they have decided to stay separately.
5. The petitioner nos.1 and 2 as well as the respondent no.2, duly identified by their respective counsel are present before the Court.
The petitioner no.3, duly verified by her counsel joined the proceedings through video conferencing.
They have verified the compromise.

They have stated that Atul Katheria And Another ... vs State And Another on 3 October, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/154782817/
1 they have settled the dispute amicable.

entities.text: Atul Katheria And Another ... vs State And Another on 3 October, 2024 Indian Kanoon
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 6. The Court particularly asked the respondent no.2, the informant, she would submit that they have settled the dispute amicably and have decided to stay separately and she does not want to proceed with the case.
7. Having considered the nature of offence and other attending factors, this Court is of the view that the petition may be decided on the basis of compromise between the parties.
Accordingly, the petition deserves to be allowed.
8. The petition is allowed.
The Charge-Sheet No.180 of 2023, dated 20.07.2023 and summoning order dated 21.09.2023 as well as the entire proceedings of the case are hereby quashed.
9. Compounding Application No.1 of 2024 stands disposed of accordingly.
(Ravindra Maithani, J.) 03.10.2024 Ravi Atul Katheria And Another ... vs State And Another on 3 October, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/154782817/
